//: Type-check scope for the Builders Network edge runtime — every function
this repo deploys, plus the shared modules they import. Carried from the
prime's builder-portal-admin/deno.json, where its header records why an
untypechecked edge function is how three alignment findings reached a PR.
The imports map pins the ONE remote package to the npm registry rather
than esm.sh: esm.sh builds submodules on the fly and re-resolves the
package's own dependencies by semver, so a transitive bump it cannot
build (storage-js 2.99.3 answered 408 for half an hour) fails every
typecheck and deploy at their CDN's whim. npm tarballs are immutable and
version-pinned; Deno and Supabase's edge runtime both resolve npm:
natively. Same package, same version — only the transport changes.
